core_obligations: Identify R^p epsilon_* with the sheafified presheaf
Prove the fppf vanishing for p > 0
Match the two presheaves and conclude (3)
difficulty_reason: Comparison of fppf and etale cohomology for locally quasi-coherent modules: epsilon is the identity functor so R^p epsilon_* is the sheaf associated to x |-> H^p_fppf(x, F) (Cohomology on Sites, higher-direct-images), part (1) reduces to the vanishing of H^p_fppf(x, F) for p > 0, part (2) matches the two presheaves through the pr^{-1} restriction formula of lemma-pushforward-restriction with properties (a)/(b) verified via lemma-pullback-lqc and lemma-comparison, and (3) follows from (2). Retained author proof at lines 4382-4429.
